# Micho Turkish Bar & Grill

> Authentic Turkish Bar & Grill located at 200 Crookes, Sheffield, S10 1TG. A family restaurant in Crookes, led by chef Micho with over 25 years of culinary experience, serving charcoal-grilled meats, fresh meze, pide, and traditional Anatolian cuisine. Open for dine-in, takeaway collection, and reservations.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://michoturkishbargrill.co.uk/): Welcome, experience overview, food gallery
- [Menu](https://michoturkishbargrill.co.uk/menu): Full food and drinks menu — kebabs, meze, pide, pizza, desserts, beverages
- [Our Story](https://michoturkishbargrill.co.uk/about): The story of chef Micho and the family restaurant, values, heritage, and location
- [Collection](https://michoturkishbargrill.co.uk/collection): Click & collect takeaway ordering — kebab boxes, family platters, pide
- [Reservations](https://michoturkishbargrill.co.uk/reservations): Online table booking form, opening hours, contact details
- [Sitemap](https://michoturkishbargrill.co.uk/sitemap): Full site structure

## Opening Hours

- Monday, Wednesday–Saturday: 12:00–23:00
- Sunday: 12:00–21:00
- Tuesday: Closed
- Brunch menu served 12:00–16:00, Monday and Wednesday–Sunday (dine-in, order and pay at the till)

## Cuisine & Features

- Cuisine: Turkish, Mediterranean, bar food
- Charcoal-grilled meats (Adana kebab, Şiş kebab, mixed grill)
- Turkish brunch 12:00–16:00 (Micho Breakfast, menemen, sucuk and eggs, brunch wraps, mini pides)
- Fresh meze prepared daily
- Pide (Turkish flatbread pizza), börek, güveç
- Full bar with Turkish-inspired cocktails
- Suitable for families, groups, and private dining
- Vegan and vegetarian options available
- Chef with over 25 years of culinary experience
